verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm notes can be exported to Google Docs or Google Sheets, and slide decks can be shared as PDF, which covers the document and spreadsheet parts of the story. Nothing shows export to reference-manager formats. Missing for 10: reference-manager export (e.g., BibTeX/RIS/Zotero), export to non-Google document/spreadsheet formats (e.g., .docx/.csv), independent or hands-on corroboration of export.
